description:
The Cowboy Cookie frameset is built for riding where dust, grit and unpredictability define the experience. It exists for riders who want a bike that feels confident on loose surfaces, encourages movement and play, and remains stable when conditions are far from controlled.

From the first ride, the Cowboy Cookie feels grounded and lively at the same time. The geometry encourages active riding, allowing the bike to be pushed into corners, drifted through loose sections and handled dynamically without losing composure. It feels eager to respond, yet never fragile.

The riding position supports both control and comfort, allowing the rider to stay engaged without being forced into a rigid posture. On climbs, traction and balance take precedence over raw efficiency. On descents and fast dirt sections, the bike feels planted and predictable.

The frameset carries the same ride intent, geometry and material choices as any complete Cowboy Cookie. Nothing is simplified. What remains open is how that character is interpreted.

The Cowboy Cookie isn’t trying to cover every surface equally. It’s unapologetically dirt‑forward. Stability on loose ground, confidence through changing traction and forgiving responses under imperfect technique define the frame’s character.

Compliance is tuned to keep the bike playful without muting feedback. You feel the ground, but the frame absorbs the worst of it. This allows for long days on dirt without the nervous fatigue that overly stiff designs can introduce.

Choosing the frameset means opting into that playful dirt‑centric attitude while retaining freedom in component choice. Drivetrain, wheel and tyre selection remain open, allowing the Cowboy Cookie to lean toward speed, durability or simplicity without losing its identity.

The frame encourages experimentation without punishment. Different setups change flavour, not fundamentals.

Every Cowboy Cookie frameset is finished individually. Frame size, colour and selected options are defined during ordering before the frame is assembled and prepared in our workshop.

It arrives complete in intent, ready to become something personal without drifting into ambiguity.

The Cowboy Cookie frameset is for riders who prefer intuition over instruction, dirt over polish and riding feel over categorisation. It doesn’t ask to be justified by distance or data—it makes sense the moment the surface gives way.

A dirt‑first frameset.Defined by playfulness, traction and confidence on loose ground.Curated for riders who want to ride instinctively—and enjoy it when things get a bit wild.

Sour Bicycles 4130 CrMo frame welded by hand in Saxony, featuring heat treated, multi-butted tubing.

Rear end machined in Dresden by Actofive from 7075-T6 aluminum.

The seat clamp is designed in-house and is integrated into the frame. Should it ever fail, the frame can be professionally modified to use a traditional clamp.

The bottom bracket is a custom part designed by Sour and fits a standard 73mm BSA threaded bottom bracket. The headtube is also a Sour-specific design.

The rear triangle is 7075 T6 aluminum and is made by Actofive in Dresden. SRAM UDH derailleur hanger and Transmission-ready

We’ve tried to make all the details of the Cowboy Cookie as straight forward as possible so know you what you’re getting into. Still not sure? Just drop us an email!

Below is the sample weight of a size medium Cowboy Cookie. This weight does not include powdercoating, but please keep in mind that your chose powdercoat may be heavier than the average coating we use. Fades, gradients, and metallic colours can weigh more than single solid color. If you are interested the final weight, please get in touch. We apply an inside wax coating before shipping the frame to your door that will add additional weight.

A Sour Cowboy Cookie frameset weighs 3.18 kg with all its small parts and suspension pivots, bearings, and bolts installed. This weight is excluding powdercoat which will add between 50g and 200g depending on your color choice.

Included with your Cowboy Cookie frame or frameset are all small parts, cable guides and bolts to build your bike. You get a rear thru-axle of course, and if you’re ordering a frameset, you get a front axle with your fork as well. Headsets are only included if you add one to your order.

We are currently working on more options for the Cowboy Cookie, but currently we offer some amazing options from Fox and Manitou that work perfectly with our suspension design. If you have any questions about tuning or clearance, feel free to drop us an email.

You can add a rear shock and other parts at check out.
